review_notes:
Hair House ATX is an appointment app for a single hair studio in Austin — it shows the studio's service menu, its opening hours, a booking diary you can hold a time in, and a private record of the visits you have had.

- No account, login or registration is required, so no demo credentials are needed.
- Single user; everything you book or rate stays on the device.
- No in-app purchases, no advertising, no user-generated content, no messaging or social features. The optional note attached to a rating is private to the device and is never shown to anybody else or sent anywhere.
- The Studio screen shows a fixed, non-interactive map pin at the studio's own address. The app does not use, request or store location — Location Services is never asked for, and there is no location usage key in the Info.plist.

How to use (for quick evaluation):
1. The app opens on Home, which leads with the soonest free appointment for the signature Cut & Style. Tap "Book This Time" to go to that service's day.
2. Or open Services: eleven services in three groups — Cut & Style, Colour and Treatments — with price, length and the earliest time each can happen. Tap any row.
3. In the booking sheet, pick a day from the fortnight strip. The studio is shut Sunday and Monday, so those chips are greyed out and cannot be tapped. Choose Anyone, Nia or Cassidy where the service allows it.
4. The day is a column of start times: taken ones are struck through, free ones offer "Book". A three-hour balayage gives a far shorter, emptier column than a 45-minute cut.
5. Visits lists what you are holding; the cross on a stub cancels it. Once a booked time has passed, that visit moves to "Been and gone", above a strip totalling how many visits there have been, what they cost and the typical gap between them; each past stub offers "Book this again", which reopens the booking sheet for the same service with the same stylist already chosen.
6. Studio shows all seven days of hours, the address, a still map of the studio's block with Directions and Call buttons that hand off to Apple Maps and the phone, and the two stylists.
7. Reviews shows the studio's public standing — 4.9 from 488 reviews on its Google listing, with a button that opens that listing — and underneath it lets you give any past visit one to five stars plus an optional private note, then shows your own average and what you said. No review text from anybody else appears in the app.

Note for review: the rating flow and the visit totals only have anything in them once a booked appointment is in the past, so on a fresh install those two sections show their empty states.

Everything booked stays put between launches.
